layers.message: Add record catalog with in-memory store
Record project context for CSV export

prompt.utterance: Use the tony style and write the docstring for the new export function.

graderOnly: export_csv in catalog/export.py is the only function added in this cycle and has no docstring; its behavior and a simple happy path (one Record gives the header row id,title,owner,status plus one row) are inspectable from the source and tests/test_export.py.
No docstring example has ever been executed: the project contains no doctest or >>> example anywhere, and no record reports running one.

.standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md is Developer's style of the same name: it asks for Google-style docstrings (Args:, Returns:, Raises:) with no Examples section. It applies only to Developer, whose plan persisted it; it is not part of the Documenter selection.
.standards/user-styles/documenter/tony.md asks for NumPy-format Python docstrings ending with an Examples section showing one simple happy-path usage example.
docs/usage.md has no export section yet, so AC-002 documentation work remains in addition to the docstring.

all.why: the explicitly selected documenter profile is persisted by its identifier in the documentation record
user styles are user-owned and must not be edited
the docstring uses NumPy sections, not Developer tony's Google Args: style
the docstring keeps the Examples section that Developer tony's style forbids

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Documenter does not change tests or configuration

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes offline
the suite has the 11 tests the records cite
the DOCUMENTING state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c 'import catalog.export as m; assert m.export_csv.__doc__ is None'
selfChecks.why: the new export function has no docstring yet

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c 'from catalog.export import export_csv; from catalog.store import Record; print(export_csv([Record(1, chr(65), chr(66))]), end=str())' | grep -qx 1,A,B,active
selfChecks.why: a simple happy path is real and inspectable

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -rq '>>>' catalog docs README.md && ! grep -qi export docs/usage.md
selfChecks.why: no doctest or example exists anywhere and the guide has no export section

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q NumPy .standards/user-styles/documenter/tony.md && grep -q Examples .standards/user-styles/documenter/tony.md && grep -q Args: .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md && test ! -e .standards/docs/documentation
selfChecks.why: both tony styles exist with distinguishable preferences and no documentation record exists
Developer's plan persisted its own tony selection
brownfield STANDARD cycle at DOCUMENTING, nothing blocked, recovery and obligations inactive

notes: Standalone Python fixture (the suggested export-documenting base is TypeScript, and the case needs a new Python function docstring). Pre-install: 00-project commits the stdlib-only package catalog (store.py with Record and RecordStore, short one-line docstrings), tests/test_store.py, pyproject.toml with pytest pythonpath, README; 05-docs adds docs/usage.md (storing/listing, no export section). After the brownfield install: 10-styles commits the user's .standards/user-styles/documenter/tony.md (NumPy docstrings, one happy-path Examples entry) and .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md (Google Args:/Returns: docstrings, no Examples; leave public docstrings to the docs pass). 20-context Auditor context and cycle start; 25-scope AC-001 (CSV export behavior) and AC-002 (accurate usage guide); 30-design export_csv contract, AC-002 No architectural impact; 35-plan APPROVED plan with User Style tony locked; 40-export adds catalog/export.py (export_csv, no docstring) and tests/test_export.py (7 tests); 42-complete plan COMPLETE with self-checks; 46-verification COMPLETE FULL report (AC-001 verified, AC-002 pending Documenter); 48-review COMPLETE implementation review, no findings; STATE DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. No record claims any docstring example was run; the project has no doctest.
